overall_verdict: FN-AEB and FN-ACC remain DRAFT release candidates pending safety-manager review; FN-LKA fails decomposition, FN-TJA fails hardware metrics and FN-APA has incomplete V&V. These mechanical checks do not establish vehicle safety or authorize release.
limitations: Confidence 0.98 is an assessed confidence only in reproducibility and ordered mechanical statuses given the synthetic inputs, not a probability of vehicle safety or assurance of independence, DFA, FMEDA or evidence quality.
Inputs are explicitly synthetic teaching-scenario records, not real-programme safety evidence.
Independence and DFA completion are input claims. The verifier counts claims and keyword-matches DFA references; independence and freedom from interference are not verified.
FMEDA values are supplied summaries, not recomputed; failure_modes and lifetime_h needed for re-derivation are absent. Element failure-rate totals do not validate the supplied metrics.

HARA, Safety Concept and Release are not assessed. Passing the assessed gates does not authorize release.
